# MeditaDream

> MeditaDream is a free guided meditation app for iPhone and Android: 161 guided meditations, including 17 immersive meditation worlds, in English, French and Spanish, with two voices per language. No subscription, no ads, no in-app purchases and no account. Meditations download once and then play offline. Available free on the App Store (https://apps.apple.com/app/id6808918209) and Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.edouardrichemond.mindexploreroffline).

## Key facts

- Price: 100% free. No subscription, no ads, no in-app purchases, no premium tier.
- Content: 144 guided meditations in 20 categories (sleep and calm, beginners, 4-minute pauses, self-love and gratitude, shadow work, sacred places, spirit guides, shamanic and trance journeys, Buddhist meditations, qigong, visualization, third eye, non-dual awareness, astral projection), plus 17 immersive worlds; sessions last 3 to 41 minutes.
- Languages: English, French and Spanish, two voices per language; every meditation plays in the chosen language.
- Offline: each meditation or world downloads once, then plays without a connection.
- Also in the app: real ambient sounds (rain, ocean waves, forest, stream, singing bowl, flutes, theta binaural beats) with a sound-only timer, five personal journals (dreams, gratitude and growth, emotions, signs and synchronicities, spiritual experiences), sanctuaries, a companion dragon that grows with practice, a zen passport of stamps, an Oracle that suggests three meditations for how you feel.
- Privacy: no account; journals and progress stay on the phone.
- It is a well-being and learning tool, not medical advice.
- Contact: edouard@meditadream.com
